item.title: China cuts retail gasoline and diesel prices by 645 and 625 yuan a tonne from 12 November
item.description: China's NDRC is lowering domestic gasoline and diesel prices by 645 yuan and 625 yuan per tonne respectively, effective from 24:00 on 12 November.

item.title: GME Oman crude marker settles at $92.04 a barrel on 13 November, down on the week
item.description: The Gulf Mercantile Exchange's official Oman crude futures marker price stood at $92.04 a barrel on 13 November, down $2.54 from a week earlier.
